text: Aaj ke din bas itna yaad rakhiye ki har sthiti mein apna dhairya mat khoiye. Jagannath ji ki tarah sabhi ke liye prem aur samanta ka bhav rakhein.
Hanuman ji se preran lein: Bina kisi sandeh ke apna sabse behtar prayas karein. Natije ki chinta kiye bina apne kartavya par tika rehna hi sachi shakti hai.
Jagannath ji ki daya humein sikhati hai ki har insaan ko apnaya jaaye. Aaj kisi ke liye bhi apne dil mein kadwahat mat rakhein.
Hanuman ji ka samarpan yaad rakhein: Jab irade sachhe ho toh koi bhi rasta kathin nahi hota. Apne lakshya par dhyan kendrit rakhein.
Gita ke saar ko yaad rakhein: Kartavya bina fal ki chinta ke karein. Aaj apna 100% dein aur baaki samay par chhod dein.
Jagannath ji ka prem behad vishal hai. Unse sikhein ki choti choti baaton ko bhool kar aage badhna hi asli shanti hai.
Hanuman ji ki sahasi drishti se dekhein: Darr ko apne raaste ka ruda mat banne dein. Apne andar ki anant shakti par vishwas rakhein.
Shri Ram ka dhairya aur Maryada sikhati hai ki har mushkil waqt mein sayam banaye rakhna hi sache vyaktitva ki pehchan hai.
Shri Krishna ki leela humein sikhati hai ki har sthiti mein muskurana seekhein. Chinta chhod kar aaj ke pal ko jeeyein.
Mata Bhuvaneshwari ki kripa humein prithvi se jude rehna sikhati hai. Aaj ke din sabhi ke prati aabhar aur kritagyata vyakt karein.
Jagannath ji ki Mahaprasad ki tarah har rishte mein mithaas gholein. Apne sabhi vichaar aur vaani mein madhurta rakhein.
Hanuman ji ki bina kisi ahankar ke seva karne ki bhavna ko apnayein. Namrata hi sachhi mahanata ki buniyad hai.
Shiv ji ki tarah shant aur sthir rehna seekhein. Bahar ke shor se door apne andar ki antaratma ki aawaz sunein.
Devi Laxmi ki kripa ka mool mantra hai shuddh neeyat aur imandari. Apne safar mein hamesha sachhai ka saath dein.
Jagannath Puri ki Ratha Yatra humein sikhati hai ki sabhi ko saath hokar ek hi disha mein aage badhna chahiye.
Hanuman Chalisa ka saar hai atoot vishwas. Jab vishwas pakka ho toh darr ka koi sthan nahi reh jaata.
Mata Saraswati ki kripa se apne gyaan aur vichaaron ko shuddh rakhein. Aaj kuch naya seekhne ki ruchi banaye rakhein.
Ganesh ji ki tarah sabhi vighno ko samajhdaari se suljhayein. Shanti aur vivek hi har samasya ka asli hal hain.
Jagannath ji ki ankhein prem se bhari hain. Unhi ki tarah har kisi ko bina kisi bhedbhav ke prem aur samman se dekhein.
Hanuman ji ki nishtha humein sikhati hai ki discipline se hi sachha lakshya praapt hota hai. Apne niyam par kayam rahein.
Surya Dev ki tarah bina rukey apna kartavya nibhayein. Prakash aur urja hamesha doosron me baantein.
Mata Durga ki shakti se apne andar ki sabhi nakaratmakta ko khatam karein. Aaj sirf aasha aur positivity par focus karein.
Jagannath ji ke Snana Yatra ki tarah apne man aur vichaaron ko saaf karein. Purani baaton ko bhool kar shuruat karein.
Hanuman ji ne Sanjeevani laane mein koi hesitation nahi dikhayi. Jab madad ki baat aaye, bina kisi jhijhak ke aage badhein.
Mata Annapurna ki kripa ko yaad karte hue, aaj jo bhi aapke paas hai uske liye dil se dhanyawad karein.
Vishnu ji ki sthirta sikhati hai ki jeet ho ya haar, apne man ki shanti ko kabhi prabhavit mat hone dein.
Jagannath ji ki Chhera Pahara ki pratha humein namrata sikhati hai. Kitne bhi safal ho jayein, zameen se jude rahein.
Hanuman ji ki buddhi humein har sthiti mein sahi decision lene me madad karti hai. Shanti se sochiye aur faisla lijiye.
Shri Krishna ke Upadesh yaad rakhein: Nirash mat hoiaye, har kathinai ke peeche ek bada karan aur seekh chhupi hoti hai.
Jagannath ji ki Bahuda Yatra humein ghar waapsi aur andar ki shanti ki yaad dilaati hai. Apne man mein vishram karein.
Hanuman ji ki tarah apni shaktiyon par kabhi sandeh mat karein. Jab aapki neeyat saf safaf aur vishwas pakka ho, toh har badha dur ho jaati hai.
Jagannath ji ki karuna humein sikhati hai ki har jeev ke prati kripa rakhein. Aaj kisi ki choti si madad karke dekhein, man ko sukoon milega.
Shiv ji ki Tapasya humein sikhati hai ki ekagrata hi safalta ki kunji hai. Aaj apne dhyan ko bhatakne mat dein aur apne kaam par tikka rahein.
Mata Laxmi ki kripa unhi par hoti hai jo mehnat aur sachhai ka rasta chunte hain. Apne aatmanirbhar banne ke safar par aage badhte rahein.
Ganesh ji ki buddhi se seekhein ki har samasya ka hal dhairya aur samajhdaari mein hota hai. Jaldbazi mein koi bhi faisla na lein.
Jagannath Puri ke Neelachakra ki tarah apni aasha ki kiran ko hamesha uncha rakhein. Andhera chahe jitna ho, ujala zaroor aayega.
Hanuman Chalisa ka saar hai ki jahan vishwas hai wahan darr ka koi kaam nahi. Apne andar ke darr ko aaj hamesha ke liye chhod dein.
Shri Krishna ki Bansuri ki tarah apne andar ke sabhi vikaaron ko khali karein, tabhi aatmik shanti aur madhurta ka vaas hoga.
Mata Saraswati ka aashirwad unhe milta hai jo gyaan aur vinamrata dono ko apnate hain. Aaj apni seekhne ki pravritti ko jagaye rakhein.
Surya Dev ki tarah bina kisi swarth ke doosron ko roshni dein. Apni positivity se apne aaspas ke mahaul ko khushgawar banayein.
Jagannath ji ki Ananda Bazar humein sikhati hai ki sath milkar khana aur khushiyan baantna hi jeevan ka asli anand hai.
Hanuman ji ne Samudra langhte waqt ek pal ke liye bhi vishram nahi kiya. Apne lakshya ko paane tak apni mehnat ko viram mat dein.
Shri Ram ka aadarsh jeevan sikhata hai ki vikat se vikat sthiti mein bhi apni maryada aur vivek ko kabhi mat khoyiye.
Mata Durga ka aashirwad humein andaruni shakti deta hai. Apne andar ke aalasy aur nakaratmak vichaaron par vijay praapt karein.
Jagannath ji ke Nabakalebara ki pratha humein sikhati hai ki badlav hi shaswat hai. Purane vichaaron ko chhodkar naye ko apnayein.
Hanuman ji ki Seva Bhavna humein sikhati hai ki bina swarth ke ki gayi madad hi sachhi sadhana hai. Aaj kisi ke kaam aayein.
Gita ke Chintan se samajh aata hai ki kal ki chinta mein aaj ke pal ko barbaad na karein. Vartaman mein jeena hi asli gyaan hai.
Mata Annapurna ki kripa ke liye har din swasth bhojan aur shuddh jal ke prati kritagyata vyakt karein. Santosh hi sabse bada dhan hai.
Jagannath Puri ki Snana Bedi ki pavitrata ki tarah apne man aur aatma ko dwesh aur eershya se doorith rakhein.
Hanuman ji ki Bhakti humein sikhate hai ki prem aur samarpan mein aisi shakti hai jo har asambhav ko sambhav bana deti hai.
Vishnu ji ka Sheshashaiya par shant rehna humein sikhati hai ki kathinaiyon ke beech bhi man ko sthir rakhna hi sachi shakti hai.
Jagannath ji ki Gundicha Mandir Yatra humein sikhati hai ki prem se har dury ko mitaya ja sakta hai. Rishton mein mithaas banaye rakhein.
Hanuman ji ki buddhimatta humein samjhaati hai ki kathin paristhiti mein aavesh nahi, balki chaturai aur vishleshana kaam aata hai.
Mata Bhuvaneshwari ki daya se prapt is jeevan ke har pal ko khushdili se jeeyein. Aasha ka daaman kabhi mat chhodie.
Shiv ji ke Neelkanth roop se seekhein ki doosron ke diye hue kadve bol ko pi kar bhi sabhi ko prem aur shanti hi dena chahiye.
Jagannath ji ka Mahaprasad sabhi ke liye saman hai. Yeh sikhata hai ki insaniyat se bada koi dharam nahi hota.
Hanuman ji ki Sindoor ki bhakti humein nirbharta aur nishtha ka paath padhati hai. Apne kaam mein poori lagan dikhayein.
Shri Krishna ki Dwarka Nagri ka nirmaan humein naye sapne dekhne aur unhe poora karne ki prerna deta hai. Aaj nayi shuruat karein.
Mata Gayatri ka dhyan man ko shuddh aur vicharon ko tejasvi banata hai. Aaj din ki shuruat acche vicharon ke sath karein.
Jagannath ji ki kripa se har subah naya mauka milta hai. Beete hue kal ki galtiyon se seekhein aur aage badhein.
